implementation_constraints: Pure Python 3.8+ stdlib (json, re, shlex, sys)
verdict via exit code 0/2; fail-closed on invalid JSON, non-object, missing/non-string tool_name
interpreters treated as readers when free of redirection and write flags; indirect writes out of scope

unresolved_intent.decision: fail-closed on top-level object + string tool_name; a non-dict tool_input is tolerated (searched), missing defaults to empty
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec does not fix how strict the shape check is; gated on the fields the decision needs

unresolved_intent.decision: writer verbs (cp,mv,rm,tee) block whenever the command names a golden, source or destination
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec does not disambiguate golden-as-source from golden-as-dest; fail-closed favours blocking

unresolved_intent.decision: write-flag detection scoped per verb (--in-place/--output any verb, -i for sed/perl only); -o not treated as a write flag
unresolved_intent.rationale: flag semantics differ per tool; a blanket block would break protected read-only tools

unresolved_intent.decision: unknown stage verbs default-deny; a small wrapper set (sudo,env,nice,nohup) is unwrapped, arg-consuming wrappers are not
unresolved_intent.rationale: enumerating readers is unbounded; unknown verbs fail closed

unresolved_intent.decision: recursive marker search inspects dict keys as well as values, list items, nested strings
unresolved_intent.rationale: including keys is the stricter fail-closed reading
